page.text:
Given an equivalence relation $R$ on $X$, each element $x \in X$
generates its *equivalence class*:
$$[x]_R := \{y \in X : x \mathrel{R} y\}$$ Every element belongs to its
own equivalence class (by reflexivity), and two classes $[x]_R$ and
$[y]_R$ are either strictly identical or completely disjoint.
